defects.evidence: Year-end changed from 31 March to 31 December via a nine-month transition period to 31 Dec 2022 (88d9121a cover and statements: nine months ended 31 December 2022 vs twelve months ended 31 March 2022). Inventory has fiscal_year_end_month 3 and counts the transition filing as 2023|FY. Transition period revenue 4,543,167,414 (as filed), profit 94,644,564.

31 Mar 2022 balance sheet has three versions: total assets 8,546,601,232 and equity 504,048,857 as filed (5ae286f0 p10); 8,241,206,787 and 145,358,156 restated in the transition filing (88d9121a p10, note 36); 7,362,827,074 as the 1 April 2022 column of the FY2023 filing (667e5934 p9). 31 Mar 2021: total assets 8,358,726,674 -> 8,053,332,229, equity 451,574,211 -> 92,883,510. The transition period itself is re-presented in the FY2023 filing: revenue 4,543,167,414 -> 4,247,672,150, profit 94,644,564 -> 100,434,990; 31 Dec 2022 total assets 7,916,649,887 -> 7,152,969,241, equity 281,342,099 -> 345,941,894.

FY2023 re-presented in the FY2024 filing (discontinued operations): revenue 5,232,231,188 -> 4,671,223,197, operating loss -640,066,500 -> -621,691,719, net loss unchanged -1,112,807,484. FY2024 re-presented in the FY2025 filing (note 36, pdf p67, disposal group and reclassifications): total assets 4,585,690,106 -> 4,613,955,733, total liabilities 5,603,825,678 -> 5,632,091,305, revenue 4,844,508,690 -> 4,847,143,434, CFI 104,055,371 -> 97,939,435, net change in cash 95,839,730 -> 89,723,794, FX -27,769,883 -> -21,653,947; net loss -197,463,334 and ending cash unchanged. Note 36 lists only BS and CF changes although revenue also differs.

H1 2026 filing (6af5dc79) restates 31 Dec 2025 (note 23, lease-term revision applied from earliest practicable date, impracticability of full retrospective restatement): total assets 4,023,468,164 -> 4,544,423,857, total liabilities 5,489,671,594 -> 6,156,616,504, equity -1,466,203,430 -> -1,612,192,647, right-of-use assets 1,368,486,825 -> 1,915,723,035, lease liabilities up; H1 2025 comparatives restated too (revenue 2,463,069,868, net loss -107,604,050). Q1 2026 filing (798c9a0c) still shows 31 Dec 2025 total assets 4,025,727,650 (a third version) and Q1 2026 loss -47,329,981 before the restatement. Q1 + Q2 does not equal H1 (see value_correctness).

251f5479 (FY2024) has textless pages 4-14 and is classed no-statements-found though BS, IS, OCI, equity and CF are present. Cash definitions differ: balance sheet cash includes the bank overdraft difference (31 Dec 2023 BS cash 235,247,382 vs cash-flow ending cash 188,141,687; 31 Dec 2022 193,825,276 vs 144,067,171).

Two byte-different Q1 2026 English files (798c9a0c, 9b40875c) with identical page text; FY2023 twins 667e5934 / 9773ab9f identical text on 66 of 67 pages, labelled 2023|FY and 2024|FY. From 2026 the entity is named AFG International Company (Previously Fawaz Abdulaziz Al Hokair & Co.) on the covers; the issuer is the same, confirmed by identical comparative figures (cash, equity) across the Fawaz-named and AFG-named filings.
